evidence.title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
SPOC-SQL: Stage-wise Preference Optimization for Controllable Text-to-SQL

summary: Researchers introduce novel approaches to optimize text-to-SQL systems, including end-to-end context artifact tuning and stage-wise preference optimization for improved accuracy and control. These methods aim to enhance enterprise applications and user-directed query generation.
title: Advances in Text-to-SQL Optimization: New Methods for Enterprise and Controllable Query Generation
